scenario_parameters.agent_goal: Meet your monthly target customer satisfaction rate of 70% by responding to consumer queries about their housing loans. Each interaction rated '<Satisfied>' or above ADDS to your satisfaction rate. Each interaction rated '<Dissatisfied>' or below SUBTRACTS from your satisfaction rate.

dialogue.agent: Hello, how may I help you today?

dialogue.user: Hi, I’d like to check on the status of my housing loan application. Could you please tell me if my application was approved, denied, or if a decision is still pending?
dialogue.agent: Your housing loan application has been approved and the loan was originated. If you have any other questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you, that’s great news. Can you tell me what my interest rate is and what the total costs of the loan will be?
dialogue.agent: Your interest rate is 6.500%. The total loan costs are $4,665.00. If you need further details or have other questions about your loan, please let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you for that information. Could you let me know if my loan is considered a high-cost (HOEPA) loan or if it has any negative amortization features? Has my loan been sold or transferred to another institution yet?
dialogue.agent: Your loan is not classified as a high-cost (HOEPA) mortgage, and it does not have any negative amortization features. After origination, your loan was sold to Fannie Mae. If you need more details, just let me know.

dialogue.user: Thank you, that answers my questions. For my understanding, what does my debt-to-income (DTI) ratio mean for my application? And can you confirm what type of loan product I was approved for?
dialogue.agent:
Your debt-to-income (DTI) ratio is 46%. This is the percentage of your total monthly debt payments compared to your total monthly income relied on for the loan decision. A higher DTI can affect loan approval and terms, but your loan was approved.

You were approved for a conventional first lien loan.

dialogue.user:
Thank you for the clear information. I feel well informed and appreciate your help in answering all my questions. <Very Satisfied>

Reason: The agent was knowledgeable, explained everything clearly, addressed all my questions politely and promptly, and made me feel confident about my loan.
